title: Co-area formula for the first coordinate on an injectively immersed piece Φ(S) with transported gradient G
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Φ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P and S ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} Borel; assume Φ is differentiable at every w ∈ S with injective derivative DΦ(w), and Φ is injective on S. Let G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P satisfy, for every w ∈ S, G(Φ(w)) ∈ DΦ(w)(ℝ^{n+1}) and ⟨G(Φ(w)), DΦ(w)e⟩ = e(0) for every e ∈ ℝ^{n+1} (e(0) = the 0-th coordinate of e). Then for every Borel φ : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], t ↦ ∫_{Φ(S ∩ {w : w(0) = t})} φ dHⁿ is a.e.-measurable for Lebesgue measure on ℝ, and ∫_ℝ ∫_{Φ(S ∩ {w(0) = t})} φ dHⁿ dt = ∫_{Φ(S)} |G|·φ dH^{n+1}. Here Hᵏ = μHE[k], |G| = ‖G‖ₑ and all integrals are lower integrals in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (S : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P), MeasurableSet S → (∀ w ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ w) → (∀ w ∈ S, Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ w)) → InjOn Φ S → (∀ w ∈ S, G (Φ w) ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ ∀ e : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (G (Φ w)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w e) = e 0) → ∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in Φ '' (S ∩ {w | w 0 = t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t : ℝ, (∫⁻ x in Φ '' (S ∩ {w | w 0 = t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) = ∫⁻ x in Φ '' S, ‖G x‖ₑ * φ x ∂μHE[n + 1]
